cache_and_warmup: For each shape, issue a full offered-width warmup with64 output tokens, then reset caches before measured work. This warms execution paths without turning cold-prefill samples into prefix hits.
Wait for scheduler running/waiting gauges to reach zero and reported offload-byte counters to stabilize. These observations are not a transfer fence by themselves.

Before each cold repeat POST /reset_prefix_cache?reset_external=true and require JSON success=true, retrying transient false responses while idle. Both installed versions expose this reset contract. A local-only reset leaves the RAM prefix cache populated.
Each cold wave uses independent per-row/repeat cache salts; warm immediately replays the same inputs/salts after idle settling. Baseline and candidate use identical salts and seeds.

Capture full before/after metrics. A warm label needs actual prefix/external-hit or CPU-to-GPU load evidence; elapsed time alone does not prove a RAM restore. Missing or delayed metrics are a qualification gap to investigate.

The client retains raw metric series and deltas, including offload loads/stores/allocation failures, prefix/external hits, speculative acceptance, scheduler counts and preemptions. Parent resource samples should be aligned using request wall timestamps.
metric_semantics: Visible-content TTFT measures first nonempty completion text from client request start. Token TTFT separately records the first token-ID-bearing event; special or non-visible tokens can separate them.

SSE event count is never treated as token count. Both releases support return_token_ids; stream deltas must sum exactly to usage.completion_tokens and requested256 tokens. Prompt usage must match the fixed token-id length.

Decode delivery rate is generated tokens after the first token-bearing event divided by time from that event to the last token-bearing event. It accounts for multiple speculative tokens in one event and excludes prefill/TTFT.
Inter-content-event gaps are explicitly event gaps, not per-token ITL. Do not apply the older harness's len(itls)/sum(itls) decode-rate calculation to DFlash bursts.

Wave output throughput is completed output tokens divided by elapsed time from first HTTP request start to final HTTP completion. It includes prefill and client/server overhead, while excluding resets, settling and warmup.
Report per-shape median wave throughput, median content TTFT, median request decode rate and individual repeats. Three B1 observations cannot support p99 or a formal noninferiority conclusion.
Any failed/truncated request invalidates its performance cell; the client preserves failure artifacts and refuses a partial-success throughput claim.

interpretation.comparison: Candidate/baseline >1 is faster for throughput/decode, <1 is faster for latency. Keep cold and warm results separate and inspect cache/speculation/preemption evidence before attributing changes.
interpretation.repeat_trigger: A roughly5% throughput/decode drop or10% TTFT rise is a practical signal to rerun the affected shape with balanced package order, not a statistical pass/fail threshold from the small initial sample.
interpretation.order: A balanced A-B-B-A sequence is preferable when time permits. If the initial run is candidate then baseline, explicitly retain order/thermal/background drift as a confounder and rerun materially changed cells in reversed order.
interpretation.memory: Compare startup physical pool capacities and parent-sampled RSS/swap/DRM memory. Equal utilization budgets can yield changed capacity rather than lower allocated VRAM. Five-second samples are observed peaks, not a proof of the instantaneous maximum.
interpretation.historical_harness: scripts/kvarn_perf_run.py is designed for old auto/native arms, K4V4, V1 and an AEON checkpoint with immutable experiment launchers. Its evidence sealing and warmup principles are useful, but invoking it unchanged would compare a different profile. The release manifest references a prior finish-performance-review artifact that is absent from this checkout; no unavailable historical measurement was inferred.
